description: Create a ticket in Zendesk via the voice/channel API endpoint. Use this action when you need to create tickets from phone calls, voicemails, or other voice channel interactions. Returns `ticket_id` and `ticket_url` for the created ticket. This endpoint is specifically for Zendesk Talk/voice channel ticket creation.

assignee_id.description: The ID of the agent to assign to the ticket.
assignee_id.human_parameter_description: The Zendesk user ID of the agent who should be assigned to work on this ticket.
assignee_id.title: Assignee Id

custom_fields.description: Array of custom field objects with 'id' and 'value' properties.
custom_fields.human_parameter_description: Custom field values specific to your Zendesk instance. Each object needs 'id' (the custom field ID) and 'value'.

items.description: Custom field ID and value pair.

id.description: The ID of the custom field
id.title: Id

value.description: The value to set for the custom field. Type depends on field configuration.
value.title: Value

items.title: CustomFieldInput

custom_fields.title: Custom Fields

description.description: Long-form description / steps to reproduce. This becomes the initial comment on the ticket.
description.human_parameter_description: Describe what's happening and include any steps to reproduce the problem. Add useful details like error messages, where it occurs, and when it started.
description.title: Description

display_to_agent.description: Optional agent ID who will see the newly created ticket. Use this to route the ticket to a specific agent for immediate attention.
display_to_agent.human_parameter_description: The agent ID who should see this ticket in their dashboard. Use this to route voicemails or high-priority tickets to specific agents.
display_to_agent.title: Display To Agent

external_id.description: An external ID to link this ticket to records in another system.
external_id.human_parameter_description: A unique identifier from an external system (e.g., CRM, ERP) for cross-referencing.
external_id.title: External Id

group_id.description: The ID of the group to assign the ticket to.
group_id.human_parameter_description: The Zendesk group ID the ticket should be assigned to. Groups are collections of agents.
group_id.title: Group Id

priority.description: Zendesk priority. Must be one of: 'urgent', 'high', 'normal', 'low'. Defaults to 'normal'.
priority.human_parameter_description: How urgent this request is and how quickly it needs attention. Choose urgent, high, normal, or low based on impact and time sensitivity. Defaults to 'normal'.
priority.title: Priority

requester_email.description: Email of the requester. Must accompany `requester_name`. Ignored if requester_id is provided.
requester_email.human_parameter_description: The requester's email address so they can receive ticket notifications. Include this only if you're also providing their name.
requester_email.title: Requester Email

requester_id.description: The ID of the user requesting support. If provided, requester_name and requester_email are ignored.
requester_id.human_parameter_description: The Zendesk user ID of the person reporting this issue. Use this if you know the user's ID, otherwise use requester_name/email.
requester_id.title: Requester Id

requester_name.description: Name of the requester. If you supply this, you MUST also supply `requester_email`. Leave both blank to default to the authenticated user. Ignored if requester_id is provided.
requester_name.human_parameter_description: Full name of the person reporting the issue or needing help. Provide this only if you're also adding their email so they receive updates.
requester_name.title: Requester Name

status.description: The state of the ticket. Allowed values: 'new', 'open', 'pending', 'hold', 'solved', 'closed'.
status.human_parameter_description: The current state of the ticket. Tickets typically start as 'new' and move through 'open', 'pending', 'hold', 'solved', and 'closed'.
status.title: Status

subject.description: Short summary of the issue. Keep it concise (e.g. 'Cannot log in' or 'Voicemail from customer').
subject.human_parameter_description: A short, clear title for the issue so support understands it at a glance. Keep it brief, like 'Can't log in' or 'Voicemail from customer'.
subject.title: Subject

tags.description: Array of tags to apply to the ticket.
tags.human_parameter_description: Labels to categorize or filter the ticket. Tags help with reporting and automation.
tags.title: Tags

ticket_type.description: The type of this ticket. Allowed values: 'problem', 'incident', 'question', 'task'.
ticket_type.human_parameter_description: Categorize the ticket: 'problem' for root cause issues, 'incident' for occurrences of a problem, 'question' for inquiries, 'task' for work items.
ticket_type.title: Ticket Type

via_id.description: The via ID for the channel through which the ticket was created.
via_id.human_parameter_description: The channel via ID indicating how the ticket was created (e.g., phone, chat, email).
via_id.title: Via Id

voice_comment.description: Voice comment details for voicemail tickets.
voice_comment.human_parameter_description: Voice comment details for voicemail tickets. Include call details, recording URL, and transcription.

answered_by_id.description: ID of the agent who answered (if call was answered)
answered_by_id.title: Answered By Id

call_duration.description: Duration of the call in seconds
call_duration.title: Call Duration

voice_comment.title: VoiceComment
